shared_elements: standing human figures shown frontally/in profile
figures with raised or upraised arms
human figures with schematic linear bodies
incised/carved line drawing on a flat surface
justification: Both surfaces depict groups of incised standing human figures, some with raised arms, which is the main and rather generic correspondence. A's figures are crude stick-like schematic bodies scattered freely among linear lines with no framing, while B shows carefully proportioned, garmented figures organised into stacked registers facing one another with accompanying sign-like symbols and offering objects, an ordered scheme absent from A.
